test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"upon".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Upon** is a preposition.
 
• It is used when mentioning an event that is followed immediately by another event.
 
• **Example -** The dog sprang upon
